name: Windsor.ai for CRM
description: Windsor.ai for CRM is a focused workspace for revenue and marketing ops. It connects your CRM and marketing-automation sources, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Zoho, and ActiveCampaign, so you can ask questions in plain language: review pipeline, contacts, and deal stages; and track campaign and email performance. Where the platform supports it, you can also make changes, such as updating a record, always after you confirm. It connects only your CRM and marketing sources, so the tools stay on task. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Windsor.ai for CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Windsor.ai for CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.windsor.ai/crm. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Windsor.ai for CRM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for CRM lists 18 MCP tools, including contact_windsor, create_custom_field, create_destination_task, execute_action, get_connector_authorization_url, get_connector_connect_info, get_connectors, get_current_user, get_custom_fields, get_data, get_destination_setup_info, and get_destination_tasks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Windsor.ai for CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Windsor.ai for CRM in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Windsor.ai for CRM MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for CRM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Windsor.ai for CRM is developed by Windsor.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
